# Tukany

> Tukany is a free interactive guitar and bass fretboard by Lucas Marques. Players can see and hear scales, modes, and chord arpeggios, practice fingering patterns, and download printable scale diagrams.

The explorer maps 67 named scales, modes, and arpeggios to all 12 roots. It supports six- and seven-string guitars and four-, five-, and six-string basses, with 44 tuning presets, custom tunings, and diagrams for either hand. Select a fret or staff note to hear its pitch. Use Copy link to share a practice setup.

## Explorer by language

- [Guitar and bass scale explorer in English](https://tukany.com/)
- [Escalas para guitarra e baixo em português do Brasil](https://tukany.com/pt/)
- [Escalas para guitarra y bajo en español de España](https://tukany.com/es/)
- [Scale per chitarra e basso in italiano](https://tukany.com/it/)
- [Gammes pour guitare et basse en français](https://tukany.com/fr/)
- [Tonleitern für Gitarre und Bass auf Deutsch](https://tukany.com/de/)

## Practice examples and instructions

- [A minor pentatonic on a six-string guitar in standard tuning](https://tukany.com/?key=A&scale=minor-pentatonic)
- [D natural minor on a four-string bass in Drop C tuning](https://tukany.com/?key=D&scale=natural-minor&instrument=bass&tuning=drop-c)
- [How to choose a scale, read the fretboard, and generate a PDF in any of the six languages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucasmkrx/tukany/main/README.md)
- [How to find backing tracks and practice drones for a key, scale, and instrument](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucasmkrx/tukany/main/docs/backing-tracks.md)
